items.title: Konitz Lee — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: he introduced me to his good friend

ctx.x: We talked for a moment about the date that you did for New Jazz with Miles as a sideman. Could we talk a bit more about that? George Russell wrote you two things. Did you ask him to do those things or did Winestock?

We were talking when I would occasionally visit George and he introduced me to his good friend who was a Schillinger student and very much responsible for that whole Lydian concept mathematically or in some capacity.
